class_name HurtBox
extends Area2D

# Damage number multiplier
const DAMAGE_UNIT = 7.0

# The amount of damage this box deals
var damage := 0

func _process(delta):
	var target = get_overlapping_areas()[0]
	if not target or not target.has_method("apply_damage"):
		return
		
	target.apply_damage(damage * DAMAGE_UNIT)


func _enter_tree():
	connect("body_entered", func(body):
		if body.is_in_group("Player"):
			body.take_damage(damage * DAMAGE_UNIT)
			queue_free())

class_name HurtBox extends Area2D


var _hurt_amount := 0
@onready var _hurt_label: Label = $HurtLabel


func apply_damage(v: int) -> void:
	_hurt_amount += v
	if _hurt_amount > 0:
		_hurt_label.text = str(_hurt_amount)
